title: Metering Service Meter Reading Schedule: Read Method, Estimates and Customer Reads
content:
How each **Metering Service** meter type is read, how long estimates may run, and whether a customer's own reading is accepted are fixed per type as follows.

## Read method and estimate limits

| Meter type | Read method | Months between field reads | Consecutive estimated bills after which the next read must be an actual field read | Business days within which that field read is made | Consecutive failed field-read visits after which an access letter is sent and a self-read is requested |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter | Manual | 2 | 2 | 10 | 2 |
| Standard AMI Smart Meter | Remote | 0 (remotely read) | 2 | 10 | 2 |
| AMI Bidirectional Net Meter | Remote | 0 (remotely read) | 1 | 5 | 2 |
| AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter | Remote | 0 (remotely read) | 2 | 10 | 2 |
| AMI Interval Demand Meter | Remote | 0 (remotely read) | 1 | 5 | 2 |
| Primary Metering Installation | Remote | 0 (remotely read) | 1 | 3 | 1 |

## Customer readings

| Meter type | Customer-submitted reading used for billing in months without a company read | Calendar days before the billing period end within which a customer reading is accepted |
|---|---|---|
| Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter | Yes | 3 |
| All five other types | No | 0 (not accepted) |

## Estimate method and true-up

| Meter type | How an estimated reading is computed | How estimated usage is reconciled at the next read |
|---|---|---|
| Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter | kWh of the same billing period of the prior year scaled by the ratio of billing days | The next actual or customer read replaces the estimated register reading and the difference is billed or credited on the next bill |
| Standard AMI Smart Meter, AMI Bidirectional Net Meter, AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter | kWh of the same billing period of the prior year scaled by the ratio of billing days | The next actual read replaces the estimated register reading and the difference is billed or credited on the next bill |
| AMI Interval Demand Meter, Primary Metering Installation | kWh and demand of the same billing period of the prior year scaled by the ratio of billing days | The next actual read replaces the estimated register reading and the difference is billed or credited on the next bill |

## Points of reference

- Only the Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter is read manually, and only it accepts a customer reading.
- **Hypothetical estimate.** A Standard AMI Smart Meter billing period of 31 days whose same period a year earlier ran 30 days and registered 600 kWh is estimated at 600 kWh scaled by 31 over 30, that is 620 kWh.
